title: Terminal Companion User Configuration v1
description: Proposed local-only config shape. Placeholder $id; update for published schema.

live.description: Open the menu by itself while typing; false = on Tab only.

predict.description: At an empty prompt, before any key is pressed, offer the command that usually follows the last one run in this folder. Off: nothing is suggested until you type. Needs privacy.recordCommands.

font.description: Font family for the popup. Empty = follow the terminal's font where it can be read.

ownPermission.description: macOS: ask for the Accessibility permission once, for goh-popup itself, instead of once per terminal app (experimental). Unsigned builds have to be allowed again after each update.

learnChoices.description: Remember which suggestions you pick (command, subcommand and the chosen label only) to rank them first next time. `goh forget` deletes it.

recordCommands.description: Keep the successful command lines you run (never ones that look like they hold a secret, nor ones starting with a space) in a private local file, to finish a started line from your history, predict the next command, and remember the values you give options. `goh forget` deletes it.

autoSpecs.description: The first time you type a program that has no spec, run `<program> --help` once in the background and save a spec read from it (like `goh spec gen`).

check.description: Once a day, ask GitHub (with curl) for the version number of the latest goh release and print one line when a shell starts if there is a newer one. Nothing else is sent.
